suggestions:
If you really think about students future, then remove Manish Gupta from PW.
Manish Sir jyada ge personal hojaate hai students pe. Humesha class room me rating ki baat krte hai Mic off kr k. Baaki bache bhi pareshan hai or chugli krne waale bacho k kaaran koi unka virod bhi nhi kr sakta kyuki next day Manish sir indirectly unko lecture me taane denge ya torture karenge
